title: Multiple Theories
paragraphs: “Have you already decided on the names?”
“Of course! The one Father is holding is Sakura-chan, this white one is Yuki-chan, the black one is Kuro-chan, and the yellow one is Kou.”
“Three females and one male, huh?”
Fiancée examined the Filolials.
“This one is an Aria type… wow, this one has a good pedigree, doesn’t it? Huh? This one’s male, and this one too…”
“Kuro-chan is male.”
As expected of Fiancée, she identified the gender of the Filolials at a glance.
“Why is Kou called without a suffix, but Kuro gets a ‘-chan,’ even though he’s male?”
Now that’s a good point. Midori and Kou are called without any suffix, but Kuro-chan is addressed with “-chan” despite being male.
Well…
“There’s no particular reason for that.”
“Pii!”
Hahaha, the cheerful voices of the Filolials are making up for the lack of their presence these past few days.
“They’re so cute. Look, everyone.”
“As expected of Naofumi-san, using animals to get close to children. It’s just like luring them by showing them cute chicks—sounds like a reportable incident.”
“Itsuki, could you stop explaining things in a way that causes misunderstandings?”
“Seriously… Naofumi, this is just your thing, right? Shota-lolicon.”
“Ren… we need to have a talk later.”
It seems Father’s switch flipped at an unusual moment. Well, he seems to be having fun, which is what matters.
“Pii!”
Sakura-chan chirped energetically.
“We’ve gathered a decent group. Let’s head out now!”
“Yeah. So, everyone, I’m sure you have a lot on your minds, but will you come with us for a while?”
“Bu… buu.”
“There’s nowhere else to go… and we don’t know if this Éclair person can be trusted.”
“Yeah. In that case, it’s better to stay with someone we know, like Rifana-chan and Raphtalia-chan.”
It seems the discussion has been settled. When I checked the party list, confirmations started rolling in one after another.
“Then, let us show you the power that proves we are heroes. Are we ready to depart?”
“Preparations are complete.”
“We didn’t have much luggage to begin with. If there’s anything we need, we’ll get it later, right?”
“The materials necessary for initial strengthening will be gathered at the destination.”

We’ve already decided to gather supplies before moving by carriage after using the portal for nearby travel. I’m also well aware of the materials needed to strengthen my own weapon. Father and the others have also visited the weapon shop in Zeltoble to copy weapons, so preparations are as good as done.
“Alright, no problems then. Let’s head out.”
“Understood!”

Is Éclair not coming? Well, she’s probably guarding the queen or something. We’ll leave her behind this time. And so, after recruiting Keel and the others and bringing along a few Filolials, we used the portal to move to a country near the Dracia mountain range. Now then, as for where the activation in the Dracia mountain range is occurring, it’s quite a distance northwest from Melromarc. It’s about a little over a month’s journey on Filolial feet. If the activation has already begun, we wouldn’t make it in time if we traveled normally. A place we can only participate in because we can use the portal… that’s the perfect description. After arriving, the queen sent a letter to the country, and we borrowed carriages and set out. Even for that country, it seems to be quite a remote region.
“Pii!”
Yuki-chan and the others were charming everyone inside the carriage. Everyone except for Father and Fiancée started feeling sick from the rattling of the carriage.
“They’re full of energy…”
“Well, it’s better to watch them than to just wait around and feel bored.”
It feels like everyone who’s starting to get motion sickness is seeking comfort in the high-energy chick-like dancing of Yuki-chan and the others.
“Buu…”
I had been thinking about leveling up Yuki-chan and the others ahead of time, but I ended up watching their joyful dancing for a bit longer. It’s quite a wonderful sight.
“They’re so cute, aren’t they, Raphtalia-chan?”
“Yeah.”
The sister said that as she approached Yuki-chan and the others, but they hopped away, avoiding her.
They seem to play around a lot with the sister’s friend and Keel, but why are they avoiding her?
“Pii!”

Ah, it’s an activation event. It reminds me of Cal Mira Island, where everyone went together in the first world. Well, we go there often enough that it’s become a fairly familiar island. Thinking back to the events from the game, I remember that event maps had caravans stationed, and you used ores that could only be obtained locally as currency to pay for lodging. That was the case with Cal Mira Island as well, but it seemed that in this region, regular currency was being used for transactions. Well, that’s probably the norm.
“The Dracia mountain range, huh… I wonder what kind of place it is?”
“I haven’t been to this activation site either, so I don’t really know.”
“Where else have you been?”

“Cal Mira Island and the North Felrat Great Forest. Cal Mira Island is an archipelago with very beautiful seas. As for the North Felrat Great Forest, well… as the name suggests, it’s a forest. A mystical forest where you can enjoy a therapeutic walk.”
I told Father and the others about the other activation sites. Both places are quite convenient in their own ways.
“By that logic, I guess the Dracia mountain range would be some hidden region you reach after climbing the mountains?”
“That’s probably the case. However, both locations had castles that had been renovated into hotels for accommodations.”
“A castle in a remote region, huh…”
“That sounds fun!”

Father’s eyes were sparkling. I wonder which loop it was when he told me he hadn’t traveled abroad much. Indeed, depending on how you look at it, it does have a fantastical charm. Cal Mira Island also had mist in the early morning, and the sunrise was breathtaking. The North Felrat Great Forest was similarly a beautiful sight. There’s no doubt that these places have a certain appeal as tourist destinations.
“Is there some meaning behind the name being a play on the word for vampires?”
“Is that so?”
Fiancée tilted her head in confusion.
Is that really the case?
“Well, there are several theories about the origin of the name…”
“Wasn’t it named by a past hero? I recall hearing something like that.”

I’m fairly certain that’s something the local count, who always serves as a guide upon arrival, mentioned before. This world is another world, but it seems that the past heroes left behind many things. It wouldn’t be surprising if there were familiar elements.
“Really?”
“It’s just one theory…”
Fiancée nodded while watching Yuki-chan and the others dance.
“There’s also a legend that the name comes from a demonic monster that ruled the region… so the truth is uncertain.”
“Going to a place where there might be vampire monsters is kind of scary…”
“Since they’re classified as a demi-human species, the Shield Hero has nothing to fear.”
“So they’re not classified as monsters…”
Father muttered with slight disappointment or perhaps exasperation.
“There sure are a lot of vampires in this world…”
“If they bite you, do you get turned into a vampire?”
“There’s a legend that a hero once asked that question, but unfortunately, it seems they were disappointed… I’ve heard that the species researches magic related to that.”
“That’s the kind of research I’d rather they not pursue.”
“Nowadays, they’ve developed magic that allows for temporary transformation. It can be cured voluntarily, and… apparently, it’s not contagious like a disease.”
“Whether trying to meet the hero’s expectations makes them good or bad is hard to tell.”
“Created vampires don’t sound very dreamy.”
And so, as we continued chatting about such things, night fell.
